meta.title: WizMark - Organize bookmarks smartly with AI
meta.description: WizMark is an iPhone/iPad bookmark app that uses AI to summarize and categorize the links you share, organizing everything from store info and events to recipes.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.body: Protoduct AI ("we") respects the privacy of everyone using WizMark ("the App") and is committed to protecting personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it is used, and your rights.

subsections.heading: 2.1 Information You Provide
items: Account information (email address) - via Clerk authentication
Bookmark data (URL, title, notes, tags)
Collection information (name, icon, color settings)

subsections.heading: 2.2 Information Collected Automatically
items: Usage data (via PostHog analytics) - feature usage frequency, screen transitions, etc.
Device identifiers (for AdMob ad delivery)
Crash reports (via Sentry)

subsections.heading: 2.3 Information Processed by AI Features
items: Web page content at a bookmark's URL (for summarization and information extraction)
Extracted information (store name, address, phone number, business hours, recipes, ratings, etc.)
subsections.body: AI features use the Google Gemini API. Data processed is handled in accordance with Google's Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose of Use
items: Providing and improving the App's features
Providing user support
Displaying advertisements (for free users)
Analyzing App usage
Detecting and fixing bugs

sections.heading: 4. Sharing of Information
sections.body: We do not share your personal information with third parties except in the following cases:
items: When you give consent
When required by law
Disclosure to service providers necessary to operate the App (Clerk, Google, PostHog, Sentry, RevenueCat)

sections.heading: 5. Data Storage
sections.body: Bookmark and collection data is synced across your devices through Apple iCloud. Data is encrypted and stored in accordance with Apple's security standards.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
items: Account deletion: You can delete your account from the in-app settings
Data deletion: All related data is deleted when you delete your account
Ad tracking control: You can manage tracking permissions from iOS Settings

sections.heading: 7. Children's Privacy
sections.body: The App is not intended for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. Material changes will be notified within the App.

sections.heading: 9. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about privacy, please contact us at the following:

sections.heading: 1. About These Terms
sections.body: These Terms of Use ("these Terms") set forth the conditions for using WizMark ("the App") provided by Protoduct AI ("we"). By using the App, you are deemed to agree to these Terms.

sections.heading: 2. Service Description
sections.body: WizMark is an iOS application that saves and organizes web page bookmarks and uses AI technology to automatically extract information.

sections.heading: 3. Account
items: The basic features of the App can be used without registering an account
Some features require sign-in via Clerk
You are responsible for the accuracy and security of your account information

subsections.heading: 4.1 WizMark Pro (Monthly Subscription)
items: $9.99/month (tax included) unlocks all AI features, ad removal, and data export
Billed to the payment method linked to your Apple ID
Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period
Cancel from iOS Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions

subsections.heading: 4.2 Ad Removal (One-time Purchase)
items: A one-time purchase of $6.99 permanently removes ads
Purchases are non-refundable (subject to Apple's policies)

sections.heading: 5. Prohibited Conduct
items: Reverse engineering, modifying, or redistributing the App
Unauthorized access or interference with the service
Saving or sharing illegal content
Sending large volumes of requests via automated tools

sections.heading: 6. About AI Features
items: Information extraction results from AI features are for reference only and accuracy is not guaranteed
Please verify important information yourself
AI processing uses the Google Gemini API

sections.heading: 7. Intellectual Property
sections.body: Intellectual property rights for the App's design, code, and content belong to us. Ownership of bookmark data you save belongs to you.

sections.heading: 8. Disclaimer
items: The App is provided "as is"
We are not liable for service interruptions or data loss
We are not responsible for the content of third-party websites

sections.heading: 9. Changes or Termination of Service
sections.body: We reserve the right to change the App's features or terminate the service with prior notice.

sections.heading: 10. Governing Law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Japan, and the courts of Japan shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
